prompt_text: Best donor management software for nonprofits
response_text:
The **best donor management software** for nonprofits depends on your size, budget, and fundraising workflow, but the most commonly recommended options in recent 2026 roundups are **Bloomerang**, **DonorPerfect**, **Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT**, **Givebutter**, and **Donorbox**.[3][4][5][6][8]

A practical way to choose is:

- **Best overall for many nonprofits:** **Bloomerang** — it is highlighted by Bloomerang itself as the top-recommended option in its 2026 guide, and it is positioned as a unified giving platform.[3]
- **Best for established nonprofits with complex needs:** **Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT** — Blackbaud describes it as an industry-leading donor management solution.[8]
- **Best for traditional donor tracking and fundraising operations:** **DonorPerfect** — it emphasizes donor management, grant and gift tracking, moves management, and mass mailing.[1]
- **Best free or low-cost entry point:** **Givebutter** — it offers a free CRM for nonprofits of all sizes.[5]
- **Best simple fundraising-focused option:** **Donorbox** — a review source describes it as user-friendly for managing one-time and recurring donations, tracking donors, and creating campaigns.[6]

If you want a shorter shortlist by nonprofit type:

| Nonprofit need | Good fit | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Small nonprofit or startup | **Givebutter** | Free CRM and modern donor management tools.[5] |
| Growing nonprofit | **Bloomerang** | Strong all-in-one donor management and fundraising positioning.[3] |
| Larger, established organization | **Raiser’s Edge NXT** | Built for more advanced nonprofit CRM and donor management needs.[8] |
| Direct mail, grants, and gift tracking | **DonorPerfect** | Explicitly supports those workflows.[1] |
| Simple online fundraising | **Donorbox** | Focuses on donation management and campaign creation.[6] |

If you want, I can also give you:
- a **ranked top 5** based on your nonprofit’s size,
- a **feature-by-feature comparison**,
- or a **budget recommendation** for free, low-cost, and enterprise options.
